# Capital Express — Credit Box (DEMO DATA)

## Hard declines
- Time in business < 6 months
- Average monthly revenue < $15,000
- More than 2 open advances (stacking)
- Negative days > 5 in trailing 30
- Restricted industries: cannabis, firearms, adult, crypto trading

## Tiers
| Tier | TIB | Avg monthly rev | Max advance | Factor |
|------|-----|-----------------|-------------|--------|
| A | 24m+ | $50k+ | 150% of monthly | 1.22 |
| B | 12-24m | $30k-50k | 100% of monthly | 1.32 |
| C | 6-12m | $15k-30k | 75% of monthly | 1.45 |

## Manual review triggers
- Revenue declining 3 consecutive months
- Single customer > 40% of deposits
- NSF count 3-5 in trailing 90 days

# Pricing Matrix (DEMO DATA)

Factor rate by tier and term:

| Tier | 6 mo | 9 mo | 12 mo |
|------|------|------|-------|
| A | 1.18 | 1.22 | 1.28 |
| B | 1.28 | 1.32 | 1.38 |
| C | 1.40 | 1.45 | 1.52 |

Holdback: 10-15% of daily deposits (tier A 10%, B 12%, C 15%).
Origination fee: 2.5% of funded amount, netted at funding.
Early payoff: no discount before 50% of RTR is repaid.

# Compliance Requirements (DEMO DATA)

- Every declined application needs a documented reason code retained 25 months.
- Reg B adverse action notice within 30 days of the decision.
- No decisioning on protected-class attributes; log the attributes actually used.
- Broker submissions require a signed ISO agreement on file before funding.
- All merchant bank data is confidential; never include account numbers in summaries.
- Every automated recommendation must be traceable to a rule in credit-box.md.

board.title: Review Stacking Copilot output
board.desc: Confirm stacking flags match credit-box.md rules

board.title: Review Decision Accelerator tiers
board.desc: Spot-check tier + factor assignments against the pricing matrix

board.title: Review Compliance audit trail
board.desc: Every decline must carry a reason code and a cited rule

sessions.name: stacking-copilot
sessions.desc: Flags stacking risk and hard declines across the submission queue
sessions.prompt: Read credit-box.md and applications.csv in this directory. For every application, determine whether it is a HARD DECLINE, needs MANUAL REVIEW, or is CLEAR TO PRICE, citing the specific credit-box rule for each. Call out stacking risk explicitly (open_advances). Write your findings to stacking-report.md as a markdown table, then print a one-paragraph summary.

schedules.title: Morning submission sweep
schedules.command: Re-read applications.csv, re-run the stacking and hard-decline screen, and update stacking-report.md. Report only what changed since the last run.

sessions.name: decision-accelerator
sessions.desc: Assigns tier, advance size and factor rate for clear applications
sessions.prompt: Read credit-box.md and pricing-matrix.md, then applications.csv. For each application that is not a hard decline, assign a tier (A/B/C), a maximum advance amount, a recommended term, and the factor rate from the pricing matrix. Show the arithmetic for the advance cap. Write the result to pricing-recommendations.md and print a summary table.

schedules.title: Daily pricing refresh
schedules.command: Recompute tier, advance cap and factor for the current queue and update pricing-recommendations.md.

sessions.name: compliance-audit
sessions.desc: Builds the adverse-action and audit trail for every decision
sessions.prompt: Read compliance.md, credit-box.md and applications.csv. For every application you would decline, produce a Reg B adverse action entry: app_id, decision date placeholder, reason code, the exact credit-box rule cited, and the 25-month retention date. Verify no protected-class attribute was used and state which attributes were. Write it to audit-trail.md and print any compliance gaps you find.

schedules.title: Weekly compliance review
schedules.command: Re-audit all decisions from the past week and flag any missing reason codes or retention dates.
